lines.text: In NASA's own data, 8 of 31 astronauts had abnormal jugular-vein flow in flight.
Near Mars, a clot can't wait: NASA lists delays of up to 40 minutes, and no evacuation.
NASA's new risk score is one snapshot. Scans, symptoms and medicines keep changing.
VTE Watch keeps that score unchanged, tracks every scan, flags emergency symptoms onboard, and checks blood thinners before landing. The flight surgeon signs every decision.
